// Generates a golden corpus of raftpb messages encoded by the original
// go.etcd.io/raft/v3 raftpb (gogo/protobuf), for the fork's compatibility
// tests.
package main

import (
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"math"
	"math/rand"
	"os"
	"reflect"
	"strings"

	pb "go.etcd.io/raft/v3/raftpb"
)

type golden struct {
	Type string `json:"type"`
	Hex  string `json:"hex"`
	Text string `json:"text"` // String() of the message decoded from Hex
	JSON string `json:"json"` // encoding/json of the message decoded from Hex
	Size int    `json:"size"`
	// Encoding of the message decoded from JSON. JSON drops empty bytes
	// fields (omitempty), so this can differ from Hex.
	JSONHex string `json:"jsonhex"`
}

// Go literal of an in-memory message and its String(), for checking String
// on values that encoding would normalise (nil versus empty slices).
var lits []string

func goLit(v reflect.Value) string {
	switch v.Kind() {
	case reflect.Pointer:
		if v.IsNil() {
			return "nil"
		}
		return "&" + goLit(v.Elem())
	case reflect.Struct:
		var parts []string
		t := v.Type()
		for i := 0; i < t.NumField(); i++ {
			parts = append(parts, t.Field(i).Name+": "+goLit(v.Field(i)))
		}
		return t.Name() + "{" + strings.Join(parts, ", ") + "}"
	case reflect.Slice:
		if v.IsNil() {
			return "nil"
		}
		if v.Type().Elem().Kind() == reflect.Uint8 {
			return fmt.Sprintf("[]byte(%q)", v.Bytes())
		}
		var parts []string
		for i := 0; i < v.Len(); i++ {
			parts = append(parts, goLit(v.Index(i)))
		}
		return "[]" + v.Type().Elem().Name() + "{" + strings.Join(parts, ", ") + "}"
	case reflect.Bool:
		return fmt.Sprint(v.Bool())
	case reflect.Uint64, reflect.Uint32:
		return fmt.Sprintf("%d", v.Uint())
	case reflect.Int32:
		return fmt.Sprintf("%s(%d)", v.Type().Name(), v.Int())
	}
	panic(v.Kind().String())
}

var rng = rand.New(rand.NewSource(20261013))

func u64() uint64 {
	switch rng.Intn(8) {
	case 0:
		return 0
	case 1:
		return math.MaxUint64
	case 2:
		return uint64(rng.Intn(10))
	case 3:
		return 1 << uint(rng.Intn(64))
	case 4:
		return uint64(rng.Intn(1000))
	default:
		return rng.Uint64() >> uint(rng.Intn(64))
	}
}

func bytesv() []byte {
	switch rng.Intn(6) {
	case 0:
		return nil
	case 1:
		return []byte{}
	case 2:
		b := make([]byte, rng.Intn(40))
		rng.Read(b) // arbitrary bytes, including non-printable ones
		return b
	case 3:
		return []byte(fmt.Sprintf("text %d \"quoted\" \\ back\n\ttab", rng.Intn(100)))
	case 4:
		b := make([]byte, rng.Intn(300))
		for i := range b {
			b[i] = byte(32 + rng.Intn(95))
		}
		return b
	default:
		return []byte{0, 0x7f, 0x80, 0xff, '\'', '"', '?'}
	}
}

func ids() []uint64 {
	if rng.Intn(3) == 0 {
		return nil
	}
	n := rng.Intn(6)
	out := make([]uint64, n)
	for i := range out {
		out[i] = u64()
	}
	return out
}

func entry() pb.Entry {
	return pb.Entry{Term: u64(), Index: u64(), Type: pb.EntryType(rng.Intn(4)), Data: bytesv()}
}

func confState() pb.ConfState {
	return pb.ConfState{Voters: ids(), Learners: ids(), VotersOutgoing: ids(), LearnersNext: ids(), AutoLeave: rng.Intn(2) == 0}
}

func snapMeta() pb.SnapshotMetadata {
	return pb.SnapshotMetadata{ConfState: confState(), Index: u64(), Term: u64()}
}

func snapshot() pb.Snapshot {
	return pb.Snapshot{Data: bytesv(), Metadata: snapMeta()}
}

func message(depth int) pb.Message {
	m := pb.Message{
		Type: pb.MessageType(rng.Intn(24)), To: u64(), From: u64(), Term: u64(), LogTerm: u64(), Index: u64(),
		Commit: u64(), Vote: u64(), Reject: rng.Intn(2) == 0, RejectHint: u64(), Context: bytesv(),
	}
	if n := rng.Intn(4); n > 0 {
		for i := 0; i < n; i++ {
			m.Entries = append(m.Entries, entry())
		}
	} else if rng.Intn(2) == 0 {
		m.Entries = []pb.Entry{}
	}
	if rng.Intn(3) == 0 {
		s := snapshot()
		m.Snapshot = &s
	}
	if depth < 2 && rng.Intn(4) == 0 {
		for i := rng.Intn(3); i >= 0; i-- {
			m.Responses = append(m.Responses, message(depth+1))
		}
	}
	return m
}

func ccSingle() pb.ConfChangeSingle {
	return pb.ConfChangeSingle{Type: pb.ConfChangeType(rng.Intn(5)), NodeID: u64()}
}

type marshaler interface {
	Marshal() ([]byte, error)
	Size() int
	String() string
}

type unmarshaler interface {
	marshaler
	Unmarshal([]byte) error
}

func fresh(typ string) unmarshaler {
	switch typ {
	case "Entry":
		return &pb.Entry{}
	case "Message":
		return &pb.Message{}
	case "HardState":
		return &pb.HardState{}
	case "ConfState":
		return &pb.ConfState{}
	case "Snapshot":
		return &pb.Snapshot{}
	case "SnapshotMetadata":
		return &pb.SnapshotMetadata{}
	case "ConfChange":
		return &pb.ConfChange{}
	case "ConfChangeSingle":
		return &pb.ConfChangeSingle{}
	case "ConfChangeV2":
		return &pb.ConfChangeV2{}
	}
	panic(typ)
}

func emit(enc *json.Encoder, typ string, m marshaler, v any) {
	b, err := m.Marshal()
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	d := fresh(typ)
	if err := d.Unmarshal(b); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	j, err := json.Marshal(d)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	jd := fresh(typ)
	if err := json.Unmarshal(j, jd); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	jb, err := jd.Marshal()
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	if err := enc.Encode(golden{Type: typ, Hex: hex.EncodeToString(b), Text: d.String(), JSON: string(j), Size: m.Size(), JSONHex: hex.EncodeToString(jb)}); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	if len(lits) < 600 {
		lits = append(lits, fmt.Sprintf("\t{%s, %q},\n", goLit(reflect.ValueOf(v)), m.String()))
	}
}

func main() {
	enc := json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout)
	n := 400
	// Zero values first.
	emit(enc, "Entry", &pb.Entry{}, &pb.Entry{})
	emit(enc, "Message", &pb.Message{}, &pb.Message{})
	emit(enc, "HardState", &pb.HardState{}, &pb.HardState{})
	emit(enc, "ConfState", &pb.ConfState{}, &pb.ConfState{})
	emit(enc, "Snapshot", &pb.Snapshot{}, &pb.Snapshot{})
	emit(enc, "SnapshotMetadata", &pb.SnapshotMetadata{}, &pb.SnapshotMetadata{})
	emit(enc, "ConfChange", &pb.ConfChange{}, &pb.ConfChange{})
	emit(enc, "ConfChangeSingle", &pb.ConfChangeSingle{}, &pb.ConfChangeSingle{})
	emit(enc, "ConfChangeV2", &pb.ConfChangeV2{}, &pb.ConfChangeV2{})
	for i := 0; i < n; i++ {
		e := entry()
		emit(enc, "Entry", &e, &e)
		m := message(0)
		emit(enc, "Message", &m, &m)
		hs := pb.HardState{Term: u64(), Vote: u64(), Commit: u64()}
		emit(enc, "HardState", &hs, &hs)
		cs := confState()
		emit(enc, "ConfState", &cs, &cs)
		s := snapshot()
		emit(enc, "Snapshot", &s, &s)
		sm := snapMeta()
		emit(enc, "SnapshotMetadata", &sm, &sm)
		cc := pb.ConfChange{Type: pb.ConfChangeType(rng.Intn(5)), NodeID: u64(), Context: bytesv(), ID: u64()}
		emit(enc, "ConfChange", &cc, &cc)
		ccs := ccSingle()
		emit(enc, "ConfChangeSingle", &ccs, &ccs)
		v2 := pb.ConfChangeV2{Transition: pb.ConfChangeTransition(rng.Intn(4)), Context: bytesv()}
		for k := rng.Intn(4); k > 0; k-- {
			v2.Changes = append(v2.Changes, ccSingle())
		}
		emit(enc, "ConfChangeV2", &v2, &v2)
	}
	f, err := os.Create("golden_text_test.go.gen")
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmt.Fprint(f, "// Code generated by testdata/gengolden.go.txt from go.etcd.io/raft/v3 v3.6.0 raftpb. DO NOT EDIT.\n\npackage raftpb\n\n// String() of in-memory messages, as rendered by the original.\nvar goldenText = []struct {\n\tm    interface{ String() string }\n\ttext string\n}{\n")
	for _, l := range lits {
		fmt.Fprint(f, l)
	}
	fmt.Fprint(f, "}\n")
	f.Close()
}
